column1: # scripts/check-nav-parity.sh refuses a family that is missing from this file, and
# refuses to add one here. Lower it (`--record`) as each row's owning issue lands;
# the file disappears when the last row does — the gate then stands on its own.
# Why these are recorded rather than exempted: each one IS a console surface an
# operator should be able to navigate to, so the gate's refusal is correct and the
# row is a debt with a named owner, not a justification for the absence. Measured
# on 5357190f, after #1520 wired FinOps and Ops/SLO (two of the six the
# console-coverage audit found; the pre-#1520 run refuses all six).
# Format: <family><TAB><owning issue number><TAB><why it has no nav surface yet>
